# Leo Matyushkin

> Researcher, engineer, poet. Materials science of nanoelectronics; software in Python, Rust and TypeScript; poetry, music and visual art. Based online — currently traveling the world.

## Science
- [Publications](https://matyushkin.github.io/science/): 70 publications, h-index 19. Research areas: quantum dots, plasmonic nanoparticles, colloidal synthesis of nanocrystals, layer-by-layer deposition from solutions, semiconductor synthesis for nanoelectronics.
- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.ru/citations?user=x0O884MAAAAJ)
- [ResearchGate](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Lev_Matyushkin)

## Technology
- [Articles](https://matyushkin.github.io/technology/): Engineering articles on Rust, Python, ML/DS, NoCode paradigm and tools, AI/LLM, history of human-machine interfaces.
- Apifornia Blog: an AI assistant that builds workflows from natural-language requests, NoCode workflow platforms.
- Earlier, at a research institute: microcontroller-based devices.

## Art
- [Art & Music](https://matyushkin.github.io/art/): Poetry in Russian, published in Polutona, Vozdukh, Flagi and zhurnal (formerly Zhurnal na kolenke). Acrylic, watercolor, colored pencils. Instrumental music releases (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music), each with its own page.
- [SoundCloud](https://soundcloud.com/leo-matyushkin)
- [Behance](https://www.behance.net/leo-matyushkin)
